A1.justification: Both PDFs describe EventSplat and contain readable methods, equations, experimental results, and Appendices A–B. Corresponding content can be matched across figure relocations and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic and real-scene reconstructions, quantitative comparisons, rendering times, and initialization/interpolation ablations in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds grayscale EventNeRF results compared with EV-GS in Appendix B.2, Table 4, and Figure 7.

M1.justification: Event accumulation, remosaicing, event-to-video initialization, spline interpolation, the loss, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. Calling the initialization model pretrained and describing faster convergence do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Appendix B.2 adds grayscale evaluation on four EventNeRF synthetic scenes. Their object names overlap the original synthetic suite, but the grayscale examples differ from its colored, white-background evaluation. The seven original synthetic scenes and all EDS/TUM-VIE sequences remain.

E2.justification: EV-GS becomes an evaluated comparator in the new Appendix B.2/Table 4 comparison; v1 only cited it. Robust e-NeRF and E2VID+3DGS remain the comparators in the retained experiments.

E3.justification: The new grayscale comparison reports mean PSNR and SSIM across four selected scenes, introducing a limited additional evaluation design. Previously documented metrics, training budgets, contrast thresholds, and held-out-view evaluation remain unchanged. The revised E2VID+3DGS scores have no accompanying explanation of a protocol change.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same initialization and spline ablations and values. The qualitative initialization example moves from v1 Appendix B.3/Figure 8 to v2 Section 5.5/Figure 5. The added grayscale benchmark does not introduce an ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. The new scene averages follow the existing reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises E2VID+3DGS mean PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS from 14.86/0.887/0.135 to 19.29/0.917/0.118 and updates its synthetic images. New Table 4 reports EventSplat versus EV-GS at 29.48 versus 26.6 PSNR and 0.959 versus 0.925 SSIM on four grayscale scenes. These are localized changes; existing EventSplat and Robust e-NeRF scores, Tables 2–3, and reported rendering times remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations 1–9, and algorithmic formalism are retained. The revised wording about spline continuity adds no formal assumption, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about event-based Gaussian reconstruction, guided initialization, trajectory interpolation, visual quality, and faster rendering. The added comparison supplies evidence without redefining these core claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 newly attributes faster convergence relative to random initialization to the guided initialization. No convergence analysis accompanies this assertion. The static-scene restriction, absolute-intensity limitation, and explanations of reconstruction artifacts remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the same implementation information, including 40,000 iterations, RTX4090 hardware, opacity learning rate, contrast thresholds, and training times. No additional implementation instructions or code/data access information accompany the new benchmark.

R1.justification: The same 85 cited works remain. Appendix B.2 newly establishes an explicit competitive comparison with EV-GS using EventNeRF scenes, while Section 2.3 more explicitly frames the contribution around event-only supervision, initialization, and trajectory interpolation.

P1.justification: Localized edits clarify initialization and ablation prose, rename prior init to guided init, tighten the limitations paragraph, revise affiliations, and add acknowledgments. Appendix B is reorganized, but most prose and the main section structure remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 4 and grayscale Figure 7, moves the initialization example into the main text, and rearranges existing figures and tables. Synthetic comparison panels are updated and figures are resized or reformatted, while the overall visual organization remains similar.

improvement.justification: v1's numerical comparisons lacked a direct event-based Gaussian-splatting competitor; v2 partially addresses this with the four-scene EV-GS comparison. Moving the initialization example beside its ablation also improves accessibility. The gains are limited by sparse protocol documentation for the new comparison, unexplained E2VID+3DGS score revisions, and a new convergence assertion without supporting analysis.
